name: Lancelot
description: The first seventh-generation Knightmare Frame, developed by Lloyd Asplund. Features unprecedented speed and agility with its Yggdrasil Drive and MVS swords.

name: Lancelot Albion
description: The ultimate evolution of the Lancelot line. Equipped with an energy wing system granting flight capability and the super VARIS rifle for devastating ranged attacks.

name: Gawain
description: A prototype Knightmare stolen from Britannia, featuring a Druid System for advanced tactical analysis and twin Hadron Cannons for devastating firepower. Piloted by Lelouch with C.C. as co-pilot.

name: Shinkirou
description: Zero's personal Knightmare Frame, built with an absolute defense system using a Druid-powered barrier. Features the Diffusion Structure Phase Transition Cannon.

name: Guren Mk-II
description: Japan's ace Knightmare built with Rakshata's radiant wave technology. Its signature right arm can unleash devastating radiation surges that destroy enemies on contact.

name: Guren S.E.I.T.E.N.
description: The ultimate Guren variant, rivaling the Lancelot Albion. Equipped with energy wings, enhanced radiant wave surger, and the ability to project radiation blasts at long range.

name: Sutherland
description: The backbone of Britannia's military forces. A mass-produced fifth-generation Knightmare that serves as the standard combat unit for Britannian soldiers.

name: Gloucester
description: An enhanced Sutherland variant designed for elite pilots. Favored by Cornelia and her royal guard, it excels in close combat with its jousting lance.
